JOYSTAR Lubbock Kids Mountain Bike - 20" & 24"
Conquer the trails with the JOYSTAR Lubbock Mountain Bike. Built for young explorers aged 7-12, this rugged MTB combines off-road performance with everyday reliability, making it the perfect choice for neighborhood adventures and forest paths alike.

Trail-ready performance: The JOYSTAR Lubbock with knobby tires and athletic frame.

Performance & Safety Engineering
"Crafted for durability and control, the Lubbock features a trail-proven geometry and a responsive braking system that empowers young riders to explore with confidence."
Built for Rugged Terrain
The JOYSTAR Lubbock is engineered with a high-tensile HI-TEN steel frame, providing the strength needed for off-road riding while maintaining a balanced weight. It features a Dual V-Brake system with short-reach levers, ensuring that smaller hands can easily apply full stopping power when it matters most.

Precision control with dual handbrakes for safe downhill descents.

Key Features & Benefits

Versatile Drivetrain: Choose between a Single-Speed for simplicity or a 7-Speed Shimano system for mastering steep hills.

All-Terrain Grip: 2.125" wide pneumatic knobby tires offer superior traction on dirt, gravel, and pavement.

Smooth Gear Changes: The 7-speed model features a Shimano rear derailleur and easy-twist shifters for seamless transitions.

Ergonomic Comfort: Features a padded mountain bike saddle and non-slip resin pedals for long-distance comfort.

Personalized Style: Every bike comes with DIY decals so your child can customize their ride.

Quick & Easy Assembly
Spend less time in the garage and more time on the trail. The Lubbock arrives 85% pre-assembled. We include all necessary tools and clear instructions to get your child riding in 20-30 minutes.

Assembly Guide: Quick steps to get your Lubbock trail-ready.

Size Chart & Fit Guide

See It In Action

Watch: The Lubbock handling rough terrain with ease and stability.

Our Guarantee
JOYSTAR is committed to quality. We offer a industry-leading warranty to keep your child riding safely for years to come:

The Frame (Lifetime): Guaranteed against manufacturing defects for the life of the original owner.

The Components (2 Years): Non-wear parts like handlebars and forks are covered for 2 years.

Customer Support: Access to our US-based support team for replacement parts and technical help.
